fields.System.Title: FDN-502 — Create a zone
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to define zones within a warehouse, so that putaway,
picking, and counting can reason about areas rather than individual locations.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a warehouse and a zone code and type, when I create a zone, then it is
  • created.
  • - Given a zone type, then it is one of receiving, bulk, pick, quarantine, staging, or
  • dock.
  • - Given a duplicate zone code within a warehouse, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a temperature-controlled zone, then its temperature class is recorded.
  • - Given a zone that contains locations, then it cannot be deleted.
